scope: Conservative catalogue candidates linked to supported canonical forms. An attack-like effect can describe a passive or alternate action; inclusion is a review requirement, not proof that a damaging action lacks implementation.
policy: Only an explicit checked per-ability record may certify packet coverage. Existing hand-coded loops remain unverified until independently reviewed.
